hypothesis: The unchanged v39 rank-16 INT8/FP16 correction can be scheduled as a real ggml CPU graph node that consumes the exact compact trained payload by pointer, produces bit-identical output to the admitted direct AVX2 call, adds no more than 4x graph-dispatch overhead at one-token decode, retains the original 7.272727 ms conservative all-64-layer residual budget, and gains useful per-token efficiency on an eight-token microbatch.

scope.graph_backend: clean pinned llama.cpp ggml CPU backend
scope.claim_boundary: exact compact residual ggml graph-node parity and isolated graph overhead only; not adapter-file loading, attachment to a Qwen linear, whole-model execution, quality, end-to-end throughput, resident memory, energy, novelty, or breakthrough evidence

llama_cpp.tasking: one ggml task for decode; token-count tasks capped by backend threads for microbatch

runtime_algebra.exported_form: output = base + bias_FP16 + ((input_FP32 @ left_INT8) * left_scale_FP16 * right_scale_FP16) @ right_INT8
runtime_algebra.payload_storage: one 64-byte-aligned copy of the exact serialized INT8/FP16 payload; graph userdata points directly into that storage

disclosed_preflight.first_compile: a move-forbidden GraphRuntime return failed compilation before execution; it was replaced with a stable unique_ptr so ggml userdata cannot point at a moved object
disclosed_preflight.older_dirty_build_validation: before the clean build existed, layer 0 validation-only calls at one and eight tokens were bit-identical; this was engineering preflight and is not evidence
disclosed_preflight.clean_pinned_build_validation: after a clean detached 4df29be build, layer 63 validation-only calls at one and eight tokens were bit-identical; no timing loop was entered
disclosed_preflight.authoritative_cases_still_untouched: neither exact payload has been timed through the v40 harness

measurement.block_order: even blocks direct then ggml; odd blocks ggml then direct
measurement.primary_stability_statistic: maximum block median minus minimum block median divided by median of block medians
measurement.direct_arm: unchanged v39 trusted AVX2 kernel called once per token outside ggml
measurement.graph_arm: ggml_backend_graph_compute over the custom binary node; graph scheduler, task dispatch, base copy, and exact kernel are all inside timing
measurement.raw_samples: retain all 504 batch timing samples across two payloads, two token counts, and two arms without deletion or modification
measurement.run_order: layer 0 decode, layer 0 eight-token, layer 63 decode, layer 63 eight-token
measurement.execution_count: one authoritative invocation per frozen case

gate_rationale.parity: the graph callback calls the exact admitted kernel on identical bytes, so any nonzero difference indicates graph data or layout corruption
gate_rationale.overhead: 4x permits ggml scheduling overhead on a roughly 12 microsecond direct node but rejects an integration dominated by dispatch
gate_rationale.all_layer_budget: 7.272727 ms is the unchanged two-percent budget at the 2.75 tok/s breakthrough target
gate_rationale.microbatch: four physical cores should reduce per-token correction time by at least 2x at eight tokens; this is a tasking correctness and usefulness gate, not a prefill throughput claim
gate_rationale.stability: the unchanged robust ten-percent block-median threshold from v39 is retained

promotion_rules: execute all four frozen cases exactly once against the exact frozen harness and clean pinned ggml libraries
a parity, overhead, latency, stability, microbatch, payload, or scratch gate failure is a terminal scientific rejection and must be retained
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
a pass admits only adapter-file loading and attachment of this exact compact node at the llama.cpp build_lora_mm seam
the next integration must retain compact INT8/FP16 payloads and may not materialize FP factors or a dense residual matrix
whole-model export still requires sensitivity classification and training across every selected Qwen3.8-27B layer and matrix
whole-model free generation, WikiText, CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, Q3_K_M/Q4_K_M throughput, resident memory, and energy gates remain mandatory
v40 cannot establish the 2.75 tok/s target, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough
claim_boundary: A pass proves only that the exact two trained v37 compact payloads execute with exact parity and bounded isolated graph overhead through a clean pinned ggml CPU graph. It does not prove adapter loading, placement on a real Qwen linear, whole-model quality or speed, resident-memory or energy improvement, novelty, or the requested scientific breakthrough.
